Coram : B. SUDERSHAN REDDY*, S.S. NIJJAR
A Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 - Order VI, Rule 17 - Application for amendment of pleading at the stage of:appeal C from the original decree - Maintainability of - Suit filed by appellant for permanent injunction decreed - Defendant­ respondent sought to introduce counter claim for recovery stage of appeal - Prayer allowed by High Court - Held: The High Court was not justified in permitting o the respondents to raise the counter claim at a stage after the issues had been framed by the trial court - Permitting a counter claim at this stage would reopen the decree granted by the trial
Decision Date : 11-01-2011 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 6344/2009 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
